title: TLP - TIIP [Translate]
body:
![TLP - TIIP [Translate]](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c5bd16286d8108b80ecda39d9a02131b705b064.png)

**TLP - TIIP [Translate]** - is a texture pack that translates the datapack "TLP - TIIP" into several languages.
At the moment this texture pack translates the datapack into such languages as: ukrainian and russian. (I don't think I'm gonna translate the datapack into any other languages)
